title: Unbundle CI toolchains and add dependency clarifier utility
author: Aisha Malik
description: Context: Our monolithic CI bootstrap logic made adding lightweight presubmit lanes and language-specific toolchains brittle; transitive devdeps caused noise in presubmit flakiness and made dep updates risky. This PR unbundles the ci bootstrap into smaller, composable toolchain adapters and introduces a small 'dep-clarifier' utility that emits a normalized dependency manifest used by presubmit guards and the dep-refresh pipeline. What changed: 1) move heavy bootstrap scripts out of ci/bootstrap.sh into ci/adapters/<language>-adapter.{sh,ts} and a slim ci/bootstrap.light that loads adapters on demand; 2) add tools/dep-clarifier written in Go to produce a deterministic dep-manifest.json and a small CLI to surface why a dep was included; 3) introduce a presubmit-step that checks the dep-manifest against lockfiles and flags unexpected transitive additions; 4) documentation under docs/dev/ci-tooling.md and quickstart snippets for adding new adapters. Motivation: reduce presubmit setup time for small changes, make dep-surface auditable, and avoid accidental release regressions when dep refresh PRs land. Checklist: - [x] introduce adapters and lightweight bootstrap - [x] implement dep-clarifier CLI and unit tests - [x] wire presubmit manifest check into staged lint lane - [x] update docs and onboarding snippet - [x] verify on ephemeral runners and CI flakes triaged. Risk/compatibility: adapters live alongside old scripts; bootstrap.light is opt-in via a new env CI_LIGHT_BOOTSTRAP=true so existing pipelines continue to work until rollout. Rollout plan: enable CI_LIGHT_BOOTSTRAP for dev and nightly lanes for 2 weeks, adjust presubmit gate to warn-only, then flip to fail if stable. Related: ENG-7123 (ci perf), ENG-1999 (dep hygiene), minor follow-up planned to add telemetry for adapter load times.
